Celebrations in Smoke#000.src: The dagger is lightly stained with blood.
Celebrations in Smoke#000.dst: El puñal está algo manchado de sangre.

Celebrations in Smoke#002.src: That should be enough to go off if you can find a member of the Kalkalrah clan. If you want to get more information though, you can continue the interrogation.
Celebrations in Smoke#002.dst: Con eso basta para seguir la pista si encuentras a algún miembro del clan Kalkalrah. Si quieres más información, puedes continuar el interrogatorio.

Celebrations in Smoke#003.src: Are you familiar with any green tea dealers?
Celebrations in Smoke#003.dst: ¿Conoces a algún vendedor de té verde?

Celebrations in Smoke#005.src: These ashes of a medallion seem to indicate that Arris really was exiled. You'll need to confront them about it.
Celebrations in Smoke#005.dst: Estas cenizas de un medallón parecen confirmar el destierro de Arris. Tendrás que encarar a Arris con esto.

Celebrations in Smoke#006.src: This looks like what Cerisa was trying to hide when she snuck in. It's a box full of... soldier's gear?
Celebrations in Smoke#006.dst: Esto parece lo que Cerisa quería esconder al colarse. Es una caja llena de... ¿equipo de soldado?

Celebrations in Smoke#007.src: I never said I thought you did it.
Celebrations in Smoke#007.dst: Nunca dije que creyera que fuiste tú.

Celebrations in Smoke#008.src: One of your clan members told me you were exiled.
Celebrations in Smoke#008.dst: Un miembro de tu clan me dijo que te desterraron.

Celebrations in Smoke#009.src: Do you know Arris? They say they're a member of your clan?
Celebrations in Smoke#009.dst: ¿Conoces a Arris? Dice ser miembro de tu clan.

Celebrations in Smoke#010.dst: Lee el tablón de anuncios en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}], cerca de {p}.

Celebrations in Smoke#011.src: The board is plastered full of old notices, but a newer one catches your eye:
Celebrations in Smoke#011.dst: El tablón está cubierto de avisos viejos, pero uno más reciente te llama la atención:
Celebrations in Smoke#011.speaker: Bulletin Board

Celebrations in Smoke#012.src: THE FESTIVAL OF THE WICKER HAS RETURNED AGAIN! JOIN THE ENTIRE MISTWOODS IN ALDWELL FOR THE FESTIVITIES
Celebrations in Smoke#012.dst: ¡EL FESTIVAL DEL MIMBRE HA VUELTO UN AÑO MÁS! ÚNETE A TODO MISTWOODS EN ALDWELL PARA LA CELEBRACIÓN
Celebrations in Smoke#012.speaker: Bulletin Board

Celebrations in Smoke#013.src: It looks like the festival starts tomorrow afternoon. Would you like to attend?
Celebrations in Smoke#013.dst: Parece que el festival empieza mañana por la tarde. ¿Quieres asistir?
Celebrations in Smoke#013.speaker: Bulletin Board

Celebrations in Smoke#015.src: Enter the Festival of the Wicker at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Celebrations in Smoke#015.dst: Entra en el Festival del Mimbre en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Celebrations in Smoke#016.src: Welcome to the Festival of the Wicker!
Celebrations in Smoke#016.speaker: Aldwell Guard

Celebrations in Smoke#018.src: Then you cannot be trusted. Leave.
Celebrations in Smoke#018.dst: Entonces no eres de fiar. Márchate.
Celebrations in Smoke#018.speaker: Aldwell Guard

Celebrations in Smoke#019.src: Thank you, enjoy the festival! You can grab a mask inside.
Celebrations in Smoke#019.dst: ¡Gracias, disfruta del festival! Dentro puedes coger una máscara.
Celebrations in Smoke#019.speaker: Aldwell Guard

Celebrations in Smoke#020.src: The board doesn't have anything else on it that catches your eye.
Celebrations in Smoke#020.dst: En el tablón no hay nada más que te llame la atención.
Celebrations in Smoke#020.speaker: Bulletin Board

Celebrations in Smoke#021.src: We can't let you in without seeing your medallion!
Celebrations in Smoke#021.dst: ¡No podemos dejarte entrar sin ver tu medallón!
Celebrations in Smoke#021.speaker: Aldwell Guard

Celebrations in Smoke#023.src: Once you get inside, make sure to put your mask on.
Celebrations in Smoke#023.dst: Cuando entres, no olvides ponerte la máscara.
Celebrations in Smoke#023.speaker: Aldwell Guard

Celebrations in Smoke#024.dst: Habla con los asistentes al festival.

Celebrations in Smoke#025.src: I hope you're enjoying the festival!
Celebrations in Smoke#025.speaker: Aldwell Guard

Celebrations in Smoke#026.src: Welcome to Festival of the Wicker's premier food stall!
Celebrations in Smoke#026.dst: ¡Bienvenido al mejor puesto de comida del Festival del Mimbre!
Celebrations in Smoke#026.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#030.dst: ¡Que aproveche la galleta de la fortuna!
Celebrations in Smoke#030.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#032.src: 'A clan member you hate will soon change your life.'
Celebrations in Smoke#032.dst: 'Un miembro de tu clan al que odias pronto cambiará tu vida.'
Celebrations in Smoke#032.speaker: Fortune Cookie

Celebrations in Smoke#034.src: 'A new love will soon enter your life!'
Celebrations in Smoke#034.speaker: Fortune Cookie

Celebrations in Smoke#035.src: 'Do not forget the danger of outsiders or someday you will have great trouble.'
Celebrations in Smoke#035.dst: 'No olvides el peligro de los forasteros o algún día tendrás graves problemas.'
Celebrations in Smoke#035.speaker: Fortune Cookie

Celebrations in Smoke#036.src: 'Avoid the forest floor, a great calamity awaits you.'
Celebrations in Smoke#036.dst: 'Evita el suelo del bosque: te aguarda una gran calamidad.'
Celebrations in Smoke#036.speaker: Fortune Cookie

Celebrations in Smoke#037.src: 'Love with the same passion that you hate or both will consume you.'
Celebrations in Smoke#037.dst: 'Ama con la misma pasión con que odias o ambas cosas te consumirán.'
Celebrations in Smoke#037.speaker: Fortune Cookie

Celebrations in Smoke#038.src: 'Your suspicion which no one else believes will someday be right.'
Celebrations in Smoke#038.dst: 'Esa sospecha tuya que nadie más cree algún día será cierta.'
Celebrations in Smoke#038.speaker: Fortune Cookie

Celebrations in Smoke#040.src: 'Beware some of those closest to you! They may not be what they seem.'
Celebrations in Smoke#040.dst: '¡Cuidado con algunos de tus allegados! Puede que no sean lo que parecen.'
Celebrations in Smoke#040.speaker: Fortune Cookie

Celebrations in Smoke#041.src: 'Mist is pretty from a distance, but do not lose yourself in it.'
Celebrations in Smoke#041.dst: 'La niebla es bella de lejos, pero no te pierdas en ella.'
Celebrations in Smoke#041.speaker: Fortune Cookie

Celebrations in Smoke#042.src: 'Restrain your curiosity, especially around odd beatles.'
Celebrations in Smoke#042.dst: 'Refrena tu curiosidad, sobre todo cerca de escarabajos raros.'
Celebrations in Smoke#042.speaker: Fortune Cookie

Celebrations in Smoke#043.src: 'You will live an uneventful life, unremarkable in every way.'
Celebrations in Smoke#043.dst: 'Vivirás una vida sin sobresaltos, anodina en todos los sentidos.'
Celebrations in Smoke#043.speaker: Fortune Cookie

Celebrations in Smoke#044.src: 'A river will both give and take what you love most.'
Celebrations in Smoke#044.dst: 'Un río te dará y te quitará lo que más quieres.'
Celebrations in Smoke#044.speaker: Fortune Cookie

Celebrations in Smoke#045.src: 'Make the most of your life, it will come to a nasty end.'
Celebrations in Smoke#045.dst: 'Aprovecha tu vida al máximo: acabará de mala manera.'
Celebrations in Smoke#045.speaker: Fortune Cookie

Celebrations in Smoke#046.src: 'Beware an uncomfortable encounter with an eagle.'
Celebrations in Smoke#046.dst: 'Cuídate de un encuentro incómodo con un águila.'
Celebrations in Smoke#046.speaker: Fortune Cookie

Celebrations in Smoke#047.src: 'Your suspicion which no one else believes will someday be right.'
Celebrations in Smoke#047.dst: 'Esa sospecha tuya que nadie más cree algún día será cierta.'
Celebrations in Smoke#047.speaker: Fortune Cookie

Celebrations in Smoke#048.src: I'm sorry, I'm still setting up, maybe I'll have something at a later date.
Celebrations in Smoke#048.dst: Lo siento, aún estoy montando el puesto; quizá tenga algo más adelante.
Celebrations in Smoke#048.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#050.src: What would you like to buy?
Celebrations in Smoke#050.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#051.src: How many would you like to buy?
Celebrations in Smoke#051.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#052.src: There is your token, enjoy the festival!
Celebrations in Smoke#052.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#053.src: There are your tokens, enjoy the festival!
Celebrations in Smoke#053.dst: Aquí tienes tus fichas, ¡disfruta del festival!
Celebrations in Smoke#053.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#054.src: There are your tokens, enjoy the festival!
Celebrations in Smoke#054.dst: Aquí tienes tus fichas, ¡disfruta del festival!
Celebrations in Smoke#054.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#055.src: You can come get some at any time during the festival.
Celebrations in Smoke#055.dst: Puedes venir a por ellas en cualquier momento del festival.
Celebrations in Smoke#055.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#056.src: Make sure you do before the festival ends!
Celebrations in Smoke#056.dst: ¡Asegúrate de hacerlo antes de que acabe el festival!
Celebrations in Smoke#056.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#057.src: I'm afraid you can't afford that.
Celebrations in Smoke#057.dst: Me temo que no te lo puedes permitir.
Celebrations in Smoke#057.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#058.src: H-hi. I, um, hope you're having as good a time as I am.
Celebrations in Smoke#058.dst: H-hola. Espero que, eh, te lo estés pasando tan bien como yo.
Celebrations in Smoke#058.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#060.src: It really is fun to finally get a chance to relax.
Celebrations in Smoke#060.dst: Da mucho gusto tener por fin ocasión de relajarse.
Celebrations in Smoke#060.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#061.src: I love being a part of the Kalkalrah clan, but at times like this it's nice to have the chance to be alone.
Celebrations in Smoke#061.dst: Me encanta formar parte del clan Kalkalrah, pero en momentos así se agradece poder estar a solas.
Celebrations in Smoke#061.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#062.src: Staring across the pond, enjoying the festival, surrounded by people I love.
Celebrations in Smoke#062.dst: Mirar el estanque, disfrutar del festival, con mi gente alrededor.
Celebrations in Smoke#062.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#063.src: It's a sort of quiet, safe calm. One unlike the rest of the year.
Celebrations in Smoke#063.dst: Es una calma silenciosa y segura. Distinta al resto del año.
Celebrations in Smoke#063.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#064.src: It's the festival again! And you know what that means...
Celebrations in Smoke#064.dst: ¡Ya está aquí el festival otra vez! Y ya sabes lo que eso significa...
Celebrations in Smoke#064.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#065.src: Green tea!!! I never know how to get this stuff outside the festival.
Celebrations in Smoke#065.dst: ¡¡¡Té verde!!! Fuera del festival nunca sé dónde conseguirlo.
Celebrations in Smoke#065.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#066.src: I'm going to spend all night standing right here, drinking as much of it as I can!
Celebrations in Smoke#066.dst: ¡Voy a pasarme aquí toda la noche bebiendo todo el que pueda!
Celebrations in Smoke#066.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#067.src: Do you want to watch the next round of fox races?
Celebrations in Smoke#067.dst: ¿Quieres ver la próxima ronda de carreras de zorros?
Celebrations in Smoke#067.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#068.src: Get ready then, because they're ready to go!
Celebrations in Smoke#068.dst: ¡Prepárate entonces, que ya están listos para salir!
Celebrations in Smoke#068.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#069.src: The rules are simple: you pick the fox you think will win a race around the wickerman and back.
Celebrations in Smoke#069.dst: Las reglas son simples: eliges el zorro que creas que ganará la vuelta al hombre de mimbre.
Celebrations in Smoke#069.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#070.src: Costs {~} tokens to enter, you get your tokens back if your pick is {~}nd, double it if it gets first.
Celebrations in Smoke#070.dst: Entrar cuesta {~} fichas; recuperas las fichas si tu zorro queda {~}.º y el doble si queda primero.
Celebrations in Smoke#070.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#071.src: I'll give you a banner you can use to cheer your fox on. It should be helpful, although sometimes they can get a bit overwhelmed.
Celebrations in Smoke#071.dst: Te daré un banderín para animar a tu zorro. Suele ayudar, aunque a veces se agobian un poco.
Celebrations in Smoke#071.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#072.src: Best of luck if you do choose to play!
Celebrations in Smoke#072.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#073.src: We'll be holding more races all night if you change your mind!
Celebrations in Smoke#073.dst: ¡Habrá más carreras toda la noche por si cambias de idea!
Celebrations in Smoke#073.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#074.src: I'm afraid you don't have enough tokens to watch a fox race.
Celebrations in Smoke#074.dst: Me temo que no tienes fichas suficientes para ver una carrera.
Celebrations in Smoke#074.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#075.src: If you need more, you can buy some at the Reward Merchant to the east.
Celebrations in Smoke#075.dst: Si necesitas más, puedes comprarlas en el Mercader de recompensas del este.
Celebrations in Smoke#075.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#077.src: Wow! Your support for your fox was really impressive.
Celebrations in Smoke#077.dst: ¡Vaya! Cómo has animado a tu zorro, impresionante.
Celebrations in Smoke#077.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#078.src: You've easily earned these tokens. Enjoy!
Celebrations in Smoke#078.dst: Te has ganado estas fichas de sobra. ¡Disfrútalas!
Celebrations in Smoke#078.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#079.src: Looks like you helped your fox want to win!
Celebrations in Smoke#079.dst: ¡Parece que le has dado a tu zorro ganas de ganar!
Celebrations in Smoke#079.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#080.src: It just wasn't strong enough to come in first.
Celebrations in Smoke#080.dst: Simplemente no tuvo fuerzas para quedar primero.
Celebrations in Smoke#080.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#081.src: Second's not bad though! You've earned these tokens back.
Celebrations in Smoke#081.dst: ¡Pero segundo no está mal! Recuperas estas fichas.
Celebrations in Smoke#081.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#082.src: Aww, it looks like your fox didn't manage to pull off a win.
Celebrations in Smoke#082.dst: Vaya, parece que tu zorro no consiguió llevarse la victoria.
Celebrations in Smoke#082.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#083.src: Maybe one of you needs to put in a bit more effort next time?
Celebrations in Smoke#083.dst: ¿Quizá alguno de los dos deba esforzarse más la próxima vez?
Celebrations in Smoke#083.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#084.src: Hmm, in the last race, blue looked like it was going to...
Celebrations in Smoke#084.dst: Mmm, en la última carrera, el azul parecía que iba a...
Celebrations in Smoke#084.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#085.src: Oh, hi. Don't worry about me, I'm just analyzing the performances of the last few races.
Celebrations in Smoke#085.dst: Ah, hola. No me hagas caso, solo analizo el rendimiento de las últimas carreras.
Celebrations in Smoke#085.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#086.src: It's nothing you'd be able to understand anyway, so don't worry about it.
Celebrations in Smoke#086.dst: De todos modos no lo entenderías, así que da igual.
Celebrations in Smoke#086.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#087.src: Isn't it nice to see kids having fun?
Celebrations in Smoke#087.dst: ¿A que da gusto ver a los críos jugar?
Celebrations in Smoke#087.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#088.src: I try to lighten his life when I can, but it's so hard to some days.
Celebrations in Smoke#088.dst: Intento alegrarle la vida cuando puedo, pero hay días muy duros.
Celebrations in Smoke#088.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#089.src: That's why I love the festival. Makes my job easier!
Celebrations in Smoke#089.dst: Por eso me encanta el festival. ¡Me facilita el trabajo!
Celebrations in Smoke#089.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#090.src: He can entertain himself, I can watch for danger.
Celebrations in Smoke#090.dst: Él se entretiene solo y yo vigilo por si hay peligro.
Celebrations in Smoke#090.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#091.src: I love when the festival finally comes around again!
Celebrations in Smoke#091.dst: ¡Me encanta cuando por fin vuelve el festival!
Celebrations in Smoke#091.speaker: Excited Child

Celebrations in Smoke#092.src: The festival is a great time to hang out with friends, away from anyone who might want to intrude on us.
Celebrations in Smoke#092.dst: El festival es ideal para estar con los amigos, lejos de cualquiera que quiera entrometerse.
Celebrations in Smoke#092.speaker: Clan Member

Celebrations in Smoke#093.src: Oh, it's so kind of you to come and see me.
Celebrations in Smoke#093.dst: Ay, qué amable por tu parte venir a verme.
Celebrations in Smoke#093.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#094.src: I'm much too weak to ride the ziplines around town anymore so I appreciate any company I can get.
Celebrations in Smoke#094.dst: Ya estoy demasiado débil para usar las tirolinas del pueblo, así que agradezco cualquier compañía.
Celebrations in Smoke#094.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#095.src: Even so, I love getting to sit on my porch and look down at all the happy people around this time of year.
Celebrations in Smoke#095.dst: Aun así, me encanta sentarme en el porche y mirar abajo a toda esa gente feliz por estas fechas.
Celebrations in Smoke#095.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#097.src: It's a lot of work to put on, but it's always worth it to see everyone together.
Celebrations in Smoke#097.dst: Organizarlo da mucho trabajo, pero siempre merece la pena ver a todos juntos.
Celebrations in Smoke#097.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#098.src: This is the only time of year a lot of us get to relax, we have to take what we can get.
Celebrations in Smoke#098.dst: Es la única época del año en que muchos podemos relajarnos; hay que aprovechar lo que hay.
Celebrations in Smoke#098.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#099.src: Hm... do you hear that? That crackling... and that smell... is that...?
Celebrations in Smoke#099.dst: Mmm... ¿oyes eso? Ese crepitar... y ese olor... ¿será...?
Celebrations in Smoke#099.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#101.src: Quick! Somebody run to the pond to get some water and put out the fire!
Celebrations in Smoke#101.dst: ¡Rápido! ¡Que alguien traiga agua del estanque y apague el fuego!
Celebrations in Smoke#101.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#104.src: Thank you so much for your quick action. I hope you don't mind, but I'll need some more help.
Celebrations in Smoke#104.dst: Mil gracias por reaccionar tan rápido. Espero que no te importe, pero necesitaré más ayuda.
Celebrations in Smoke#104.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#106.src: Can any of you show me a medallion?
Celebrations in Smoke#106.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#107.src: Just as I thought. All of you will be held until we can figure out the truth.
Celebrations in Smoke#107.dst: Justo lo que pensaba. Quedaréis retenidos hasta que averigüemos la verdad.
Celebrations in Smoke#107.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#108.src: Into that house, all three of you.
Celebrations in Smoke#108.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#109.src: There will have to be an investigation into this incident and you're one person I'm positive didn't start the fire.
Celebrations in Smoke#109.dst: Habrá que investigar este incidente, y tú eres la única persona que sé con certeza que no provocó el fuego.
Celebrations in Smoke#109.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#111.src: Follow the Festival Organizer into the house at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Celebrations in Smoke#111.dst: Sigue al organizador del festival hasta la casa en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Celebrations in Smoke#112.src: Thank you so much for your help again, without your assistance the festival would have been ruined.
Celebrations in Smoke#112.dst: Mil gracias de nuevo por tu ayuda; sin ti el festival se habría echado a perder.
Celebrations in Smoke#112.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#113.src: I cannot express my gratitude more effusely, but I'm afraid I must ask more of you.
Celebrations in Smoke#113.dst: No puedo expresar mi gratitud con más efusión, pero me temo que debo pedirte algo más.
Celebrations in Smoke#113.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#114.src: You see, I do not believe that fire was set by an accident. There's a vandal in our midst and I fear the worst.
Celebrations in Smoke#114.dst: Verás, no creo que ese fuego fuera un accidente. Hay un saboteador entre nosotros y me temo lo peor.
Celebrations in Smoke#114.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#115.src: Just as generations ago, when our ancestors first exposed and immolated the changeling threat that we are supposed to be celebrating today, we must remain vigilant!
Celebrations in Smoke#115.dst: ¡Igual que hace generaciones, cuando nuestros antepasados desenmascararon y quemaron por primera vez la amenaza cambiaformas que hoy celebramos, debemos seguir alerta!
Celebrations in Smoke#115.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#116.src: Unfortunately... the festival has always been a time when that vigilance has lapsed a bit. We have an unwelcome attendee.
Celebrations in Smoke#116.dst: Por desgracia... el festival siempre ha sido una época en la que esa vigilancia se relaja un poco. Tenemos un asistente indeseado.
Celebrations in Smoke#116.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#117.src: I suspect that flame was set by a changeling, hoping to use the fire as a distraction to infiltrate the festival. To catch someone off guard and take their form.
Celebrations in Smoke#117.dst: Sospecho que esa llama la prendió un cambiaformas, con la idea de usar el fuego como distracción para infiltrarse en el festival. Para pillar a alguien desprevenido y adoptar su forma.
Celebrations in Smoke#117.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#118.src: Due to your efforts, they were unable to do so. But they could not have gone far.
Celebrations in Smoke#118.dst: Gracias a tus esfuerzos no lo consiguió. Pero no puede haber ido lejos.
Celebrations in Smoke#118.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#119.src: I rounded up the three people nearest to where the fire ignited and found all of them had snuck in without a medallion!
Celebrations in Smoke#119.dst: Reuní a las tres personas más cercanas al foco del fuego ¡y resulta que las tres se habían colado sin medallón!
Celebrations in Smoke#119.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#120.src: While I keep them held here... I'd ask of you to interrogate them and, if needed, search around the festival to find information on who they really are.
Celebrations in Smoke#120.dst: Mientras los retengo aquí... te pediría que los interrogues y, si hace falta, busques por el festival información sobre quiénes son en realidad.
Celebrations in Smoke#120.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#121.src: Once you have unmasked each of them for who they really are, return to me and tell me which one is a changeling in disguise. I can handle matters from there.
Celebrations in Smoke#121.dst: Cuando hayas desenmascarado a cada uno y sepas quién es de verdad, vuelve y dime cuál es el cambiaformas disfrazado. A partir de ahí yo me encargo.
Celebrations in Smoke#121.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#122.src: Take this book. You can write any notes you take while investigating down to check later.
Celebrations in Smoke#122.dst: Toma este libro. Puedes anotar en él lo que descubras durante la investigación y consultarlo luego.
Celebrations in Smoke#122.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#123.src: Once you've investigated all of them, you can return to me.
Celebrations in Smoke#123.dst: Cuando hayas investigado a los tres, vuelve a verme.
Celebrations in Smoke#123.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#124.src: Find evidence against the three suspects.
Celebrations in Smoke#124.dst: Encuentra pruebas contra los tres sospechosos.

Celebrations in Smoke#125.src: Come back to me once you've found what they're all hiding.
Celebrations in Smoke#125.dst: Vuelve cuando hayas averiguado qué ocultan todos.
Celebrations in Smoke#125.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#126.src: I hope you're enjoying the festival!
Celebrations in Smoke#126.speaker: Aldwell Guard

Celebrations in Smoke#129.src: I don't know how, but this alley must have slipped through our planning.
Celebrations in Smoke#129.dst: No sé cómo, pero este callejón se nos debió de escapar al planificarlo.
Celebrations in Smoke#129.speaker: Aldwell Guard

Celebrations in Smoke#130.src: I'll stand here for now to make sure no one can get in.
Celebrations in Smoke#130.dst: Me quedaré aquí de momento para que nadie pueda entrar.
Celebrations in Smoke#130.speaker: Aldwell Guard

Celebrations in Smoke#131.src: I'm so grateful you warned us before anyone bad might have noticed it.
Celebrations in Smoke#131.dst: Menos mal que nos avisaste antes de que lo viera algún malhechor.
Celebrations in Smoke#131.speaker: Aldwell Guard

Celebrations in Smoke#132.src: Thank you so much for exposing that gap in our security!
Celebrations in Smoke#132.dst: ¡Muchísimas gracias por descubrir ese fallo en nuestra seguridad!
Celebrations in Smoke#132.speaker: Aldwell Guard

Celebrations in Smoke#133.src: I'm, um, Arris. I don't know what's happening, I got shoved into here by the festival organizer with these other two.
Celebrations in Smoke#133.dst: Soy, eh, Arris. No sé qué pasa; el organizador del festival me metió aquí con estos otros dos.

Celebrations in Smoke#134.src: Why are you admitting that you're a thief?
Celebrations in Smoke#134.dst: ¿Por qué admites que eres una ladrona?

Celebrations in Smoke#136.src: Some regions are circled, appearing to indicate the location of easy game.
Celebrations in Smoke#136.dst: Hay zonas marcadas con un círculo; parecen señalar dónde hay caza fácil.

Celebrations in Smoke#137.src: That should be enough to go off if you can find someone who was observant enough to see Cerisa sneak in. If you want to get more information though, you can continue the interrogation.
Celebrations in Smoke#137.dst: Con eso basta para seguir la pista si encuentras a alguien lo bastante observador como para ver colarse a Cerisa. Si quieres más información, puedes continuar el interrogatorio.

Celebrations in Smoke#138.src: New Quest Start: Celebrations in Smoke
Celebrations in Smoke#138.dst: Nueva misión iniciada: Fiesta hecha humo

Celebrations in Smoke#139.src: From the information you have, he just looks like a hunter who really likes green tea?
Celebrations in Smoke#139.dst: Con la información que tienes, ¿no parece solo un cazador al que le encanta el té verde?

Celebrations in Smoke#140.src: It's still stuck. Maybe try again, pulling even harder?
Celebrations in Smoke#140.dst: Sigue atascado. ¿Y si lo intentas otra vez tirando más fuerte?

Celebrations in Smoke#141.src: You wouldn't know of anyone at all who claimed to be a green tea merchant?
Celebrations in Smoke#141.dst: ¿No conocerás a nadie que se haga llamar mercader de té verde?

Celebrations in Smoke#142.src: Do you want to wear the fox mask?

Celebrations in Smoke#143.src: Based on what you've seen here, while Burick does have a lot of green tea, there's no evidence he's a merchant.
Celebrations in Smoke#143.dst: Por lo que has visto aquí, Burick tiene mucho té verde, pero nada prueba que sea mercader.

Celebrations in Smoke#146.src: Ask the clan member further questions?

Celebrations in Smoke#147.src: What does it even mean to be a trader in the {p}?

Celebrations in Smoke#148.src: Did you see who burned down the wickerman?
Celebrations in Smoke#148.dst: ¿Viste quién quemó al hombre de mimbre?

Celebrations in Smoke#150.src: Ask the tea enthusiast further questions?

Celebrations in Smoke#151.src: Why did you burn down the wickerman?
Celebrations in Smoke#151.dst: ¿Por qué quemaste al hombre de mimbre?

Celebrations in Smoke#152.src: You'll have to interrogate him again to see if you can get any new information.
Celebrations in Smoke#152.dst: Tendrás que interrogarlo otra vez a ver si sacas información nueva.

Celebrations in Smoke#153.src: I found your camp. There's green tea, but nothing else I would expect from a merchant
Celebrations in Smoke#153.dst: Encontré tu campamento. Hay té verde, pero nada más de lo que esperaría de un mercader

Celebrations in Smoke#154.src: I'm simply an ordinary member of the Kalkalrah clan, I don't know what's happening.
Celebrations in Smoke#154.dst: Solo soy un miembro corriente del clan Kalkalrah, no sé qué está pasando.
Celebrations in Smoke#154.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#155.src: Please don't accuse me of doing whatever you think I did, please.
Celebrations in Smoke#155.dst: Por favor, no me acuses de lo que creas que hice, por favor.
Celebrations in Smoke#155.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#156.src: Nothing, I don't think. Or, well, that's not what I meant.
Celebrations in Smoke#156.dst: Nada, creo. O, bueno, no quería decir eso.
Celebrations in Smoke#156.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#157.src: I only, um, do general upkeep. Fixing stuff and cleaning stuff, I mean.
Celebrations in Smoke#157.dst: Solo hago, eh, mantenimiento general. Arreglar cosas y limpiar, quiero decir.
Celebrations in Smoke#157.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#158.src: There's not much more to say than that, you know?
Celebrations in Smoke#158.dst: No hay mucho más que decir, ¿sabes?
Celebrations in Smoke#158.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#159.src: I'm nothing more than a helpful member of my clan who assists in the, uh- in the "making everyone live together with ease" part of clan life!
Celebrations in Smoke#159.dst: ¡No soy más que un miembro servicial de mi clan que ayuda con la, eh... con la parte de "que todos convivan sin problemas"!
Celebrations in Smoke#159.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#160.src: That's what I mean by nothing, you see, that's what I meant when I said that.
Celebrations in Smoke#160.dst: A eso me refería con nada, ¿ves?, a eso me refería al decirlo.
Celebrations in Smoke#160.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#161.src: I don't literally do nothing, obviously, that would be dumb. I have an important role and am, uh, valued by my clan.
Celebrations in Smoke#161.dst: No es que no haga literalmente nada, claro, eso sería absurdo. Tengo un papel importante y, eh, mi clan me valora.
Celebrations in Smoke#161.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#162.src: But it isn't super important or cool or anything, that's what I meant by nothing.
Celebrations in Smoke#162.dst: Pero no es superimportante ni guay ni nada, a eso me refería con nada.
Celebrations in Smoke#162.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#163.src: Oh, that's what you meant. You, um, wanted a specific answer.
Celebrations in Smoke#163.dst: Ah, a eso te referías. Querías, eh, una respuesta concreta.
Celebrations in Smoke#163.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#164.src: Okay. I can give you that.
Celebrations in Smoke#164.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#165.src: Like sometimes I will guard things. I will, um, um, stand watch for changelings or thieves or animals!
Celebrations in Smoke#165.dst: A veces vigilo cosas. ¡Hago, eh, eh, guardia por si hay cambiaformas, ladrones o animales!
Celebrations in Smoke#165.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#166.src: Or anything trying to steal. We try to stop people from stealing from us.
Celebrations in Smoke#166.dst: O cualquier cosa que quiera robar. Intentamos que no nos roben.
Celebrations in Smoke#166.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#168.src: Oh, sorry, I'm not trying to be.
Celebrations in Smoke#168.dst: Ah, perdona, no es mi intención.
Celebrations in Smoke#168.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#169.src: I'm not, um, sure what's happening. And that makes me a little nervous, can you understand?
Celebrations in Smoke#169.dst: No tengo, eh, ni idea de qué pasa. Y eso me da algo de nervios, ¿lo entiendes?
Celebrations in Smoke#169.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#170.src: All this investigation stuff makes me feel like I did something wrong. And I didn't do anything wrong!
Celebrations in Smoke#170.dst: Todo esto de la investigación me hace sentir que hice algo malo. ¡Y no hice nada malo!
Celebrations in Smoke#170.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#171.src: But it's hard to prove that and so I get nervous and stumble over the things I'm saying and misstate what I really mean which only makes it harder!
Celebrations in Smoke#171.dst: Pero eso cuesta demostrarlo, así que me entran los nervios, me trabo al hablar y digo mal lo que quiero decir, ¡y eso lo complica todo más!
Celebrations in Smoke#171.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#172.src: Sorry. I don't think I'm helping my case.
Celebrations in Smoke#172.dst: Perdona. No creo que me esté ayudando.
Celebrations in Smoke#172.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#174.src: I think a little bit? But obviously not as much as this! Like when I'm under interrogation for something I didn't do even though you really seem to think I did.
Celebrations in Smoke#174.dst: ¿Un poco, creo? ¡Pero está claro que no tanto como ahora! Como cuando me interrogan por algo que no hice aunque tú parezcas muy convencido de que sí.
Celebrations in Smoke#174.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#175.src: Well, um, of course you do. You're going to think I committed arson or something and then report me and everything will be horrible.
Celebrations in Smoke#175.dst: Bueno, eh, claro que sí. Vas a pensar que provoqué un incendio o algo así, luego me denunciarás y todo será horrible.
Celebrations in Smoke#175.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#176.src: There's no way you don't think I didn't. Look at how much time you're spending interrogating me compared to everyone else.
Celebrations in Smoke#176.dst: Es imposible que no lo pienses. Mira cuánto tiempo llevas interrogándome a mí comparado con los demás.
Celebrations in Smoke#176.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#177.src: Please. Please don't. I didn't do it I promise I didn't do it, please don't think that I did it.
Celebrations in Smoke#177.dst: Por favor. Por favor, no. No lo hice, te lo prometo, no lo hice, por favor no pienses que fui yo.
Celebrations in Smoke#177.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#178.src: I'm innocent I promise please, I didn't do anything I didn't I swear.
Celebrations in Smoke#178.dst: Soy inocente te lo prometo por favor, no hice nada no lo hice lo juro.
Celebrations in Smoke#178.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#185.src: Sorry I don't think I'm, uh, cut out for that, sorry.
Celebrations in Smoke#185.dst: Perdona, creo que no valgo, eh, para eso, perdona.
Celebrations in Smoke#185.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#187.src: No, I don't think- I didn't see.
Celebrations in Smoke#187.dst: No, creo que no- No lo vi.
Celebrations in Smoke#187.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#188.src: Maybe I saw some movement out of the corner of my eye? But that could have been nothing.
Celebrations in Smoke#188.dst: ¿Puede que viera algo moverse con el rabillo del ojo? Pero eso podría no ser nada.
Celebrations in Smoke#188.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#189.src: It's hard to know, I wasn't really paying attention at the time and now you're asking me these questions like I have some sort of, um, picture perfect memory!
Celebrations in Smoke#189.dst: Es difícil saberlo, en ese momento no estaba prestando atención y ahora me haces estas preguntas como si tuviera una, eh, ¡memoria fotográfica perfecta!
Celebrations in Smoke#189.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#190.src: Even though I definitely don't! And wasn't even trying to remember what was happening in the first place!
Celebrations in Smoke#190.dst: ¡Que desde luego no tengo! ¡Y encima ni siquiera intentaba recordar lo que pasaba!
Celebrations in Smoke#190.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#191.src: Sorry, I was shouting, wasn't I. I didn't mean to. I'm only stressed. Sorry.
Celebrations in Smoke#191.dst: Perdona, estaba gritando, ¿verdad? No quería. Es el estrés. Perdona.
Celebrations in Smoke#191.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#192.src: I didn't! I promise I didn't.
Celebrations in Smoke#192.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#193.src: Please don't think I tried to, I promise I have no idea what you're talking about.
Celebrations in Smoke#193.dst: Por favor, no pienses que lo intenté, te juro que no sé de qué hablas.
Celebrations in Smoke#193.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#194.src: All that I was doing was sitting there quietly and then all of a sudden behind me there were really big flames and then before I could even act you threw water on them and saved the wickerman and then I was being brought in here even though I
Celebrations in Smoke#194.dst: Lo único que hacía era estar ahí sin molestar a nadie y de repente detrás de mí había unas llamas enormes y antes de que pudiera reaccionar tú les echaste agua y salvaste al hombre de mimbre y luego me trajeron aquí aunque yo
Celebrations in Smoke#194.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#195.src: didn't do anything and am just an ordinary clan member and have nothing to hide.
Celebrations in Smoke#195.dst: no hice nada y solo soy un miembro corriente del clan y no tengo nada que ocultar.
Celebrations in Smoke#195.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#196.src: I promise I didn't try to burn down the wickerman.
Celebrations in Smoke#196.dst: Te prometo que no intenté quemar al hombre de mimbre.
Celebrations in Smoke#196.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#197.src: Find someone who might know something about Arris's clan.
Celebrations in Smoke#197.dst: Encuentra a alguien que pueda saber algo del clan de Arris.

Celebrations in Smoke#198.src: I love being a part of the Kalkalrah clan, but at times like this it's nice to have the chance to be alone.
Celebrations in Smoke#198.dst: Me encanta formar parte del clan Kalkalrah, pero en momentos así se agradece poder estar a solas.
Celebrations in Smoke#198.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#199.src: Staring across the pond, enjoying the festival, surrounded by people I love.
Celebrations in Smoke#199.dst: Mirar el estanque, disfrutar del festival, con mi gente alrededor.
Celebrations in Smoke#199.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#200.src: It's a sort of quiet, safe calm. One unlike the rest of the year.
Celebrations in Smoke#200.dst: Es una calma silenciosa y segura. Distinta al resto del año.
Celebrations in Smoke#200.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#201.src: Hmm? Ah. Yes, unfortunately I do.
Celebrations in Smoke#201.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#202.src: They were a member of our clan until a week ago, when they were expelled and exiled.
Celebrations in Smoke#202.dst: Arris fue miembro de nuestro clan hasta hace una semana. Entonces llegaron la expulsión y el destierro.
Celebrations in Smoke#202.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#203.src: Their old medallion was handed to me to burn. In fact, just on my way into the festival I threw its ashes up the tallest tree in {p}.
Celebrations in Smoke#203.dst: Su antiguo medallón me lo dieron a mí para quemarlo. De hecho, de camino al festival lancé sus cenizas al árbol más alto de {p}.
Celebrations in Smoke#203.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#204.src: Interrogated them? Oh, I hope they haven't done anything bad.
Celebrations in Smoke#204.dst: ¿Interrogando a Arris? Ay, espero que no haya hecho nada malo.
Celebrations in Smoke#204.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#205.src: You know, they were always a bit troubled. But I don't think they're bad. They just weren't suited for clan life.
Celebrations in Smoke#205.dst: ¿Sabes? Arris siempre tuvo problemas. No creo que sea mala persona. Simplemente no encajaba en la vida del clan.
Celebrations in Smoke#205.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#207.src: The fate they were given will be a hard one though. Most exiles don't survive a year.
Celebrations in Smoke#207.dst: Aun así, la suerte que le ha tocado será dura. La mayoría de los desterrados no dura ni un año.
Celebrations in Smoke#207.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#208.src: Not as much as I wish you could. Please treat them with kindness though, they only lie out of fear.
Celebrations in Smoke#208.dst: No tanto como me gustaría. Pero trata a Arris con amabilidad: si miente, es solo por miedo.
Celebrations in Smoke#208.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#209.src: I do not mean to be rude, but you cut an imposing figure. There's a lot to be afraid of.
Celebrations in Smoke#209.dst: No quiero faltarte al respeto, pero tu figura impone. Hay mucho que temer.
Celebrations in Smoke#209.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#210.src: I hope they stays well, even if they are troubled.
Celebrations in Smoke#210.dst: Espero que a Arris le vaya bien, pese a todo.
Celebrations in Smoke#210.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#211.src: No no no, that isn't true at all.
Celebrations in Smoke#211.dst: No no no, eso no es verdad.
Celebrations in Smoke#211.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#212.src: I have no idea who or what you were talking to but I can assure you I, uh, was not exiled from my clan very recently.
Celebrations in Smoke#212.dst: No tengo ni idea de con quién o con qué hablabas, pero te aseguro que a mí, eh, no me desterraron de mi clan hace nada.
Celebrations in Smoke#212.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#213.src: You don't have any proof of it, right? Right? So it's my word against theirs, there is no reason to believe anything that they have to say over me.
Celebrations in Smoke#213.dst: No tienes ninguna prueba, ¿verdad? ¿Verdad? Es mi palabra contra la suya, no hay motivo para creerles a ellos antes que a mí.
Celebrations in Smoke#213.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#214.src: I'm an, um, ordinary clan member who got caught up in something that I do not understand.
Celebrations in Smoke#214.dst: Soy, eh, un miembro corriente del clan que se ha visto metido en algo que no entiende.
Celebrations in Smoke#214.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#215.src: Search the tallest tree in {p} for Arris's burnt medallion.
Celebrations in Smoke#215.dst: Busca en el árbol más alto de {p} el medallón quemado de Arris.

Celebrations in Smoke#218.src: Yes I was exiled from my clan and yes I did lie to you but I promise I didn't do anything else bad.
Celebrations in Smoke#218.dst: Sí, me desterraron de mi clan y sí, te mentí, pero te prometo que no hice nada más malo.
Celebrations in Smoke#218.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#219.src: I don't know who burned down the wickerman but it wasn't me, you have to believe me.
Celebrations in Smoke#219.dst: No sé quién quemó al hombre de mimbre, pero no fui yo, tienes que creerme.
Celebrations in Smoke#219.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#220.src: I only lied because I panicked and I'm sorry for panicking but please please please you cannot tell them that I'm a changeling or whatever.
Celebrations in Smoke#220.dst: Mentí solo porque me entró el pánico y siento que me entrara, pero por favor por favor por favor no puedes decirles que soy un cambiaformas ni nada de eso.
Celebrations in Smoke#220.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#222.src: Because they all thought I stole something! Even though I promise, I promise I didn't.
Celebrations in Smoke#222.dst: ¡Porque todos creyeron que robé algo! Aunque te prometo, te prometo que no lo hice.
Celebrations in Smoke#222.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#223.src: I was supposed to be keeping watch over our clan's stores. And I don't know how, but a box of our special green tea went missing.
Celebrations in Smoke#223.dst: Se suponía que yo vigilaba el almacén del clan. Y no sé cómo, pero desapareció una caja de nuestro té verde especial.
Celebrations in Smoke#223.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#224.src: I promise I didn't steal it, I really do. But none of them believed me, it somehow disappeared.
Celebrations in Smoke#224.dst: Te prometo que no la robé, de verdad. Pero ninguno me creyó; desapareció y ya está.
Celebrations in Smoke#224.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#225.src: They said I had lost years of trust with them, over something I swear I didn't do, and kicked me out.
Celebrations in Smoke#225.dst: Dijeron que había perdido años de confianza por algo que juro que no hice, y me echaron.
Celebrations in Smoke#225.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#226.src: Since then, I've been having to find my own way to survive. I've, uh, not been very good at that.
Celebrations in Smoke#226.dst: Desde entonces he tenido que buscarme la vida por mi cuenta. Y, eh, no se me ha dado muy bien.
Celebrations in Smoke#226.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#227.src: Maybe a week? I- I- I'm not exactly sure. It has been difficult keeping track of time.
Celebrations in Smoke#227.dst: ¿Una semana, quizá? N-n-no lo sé con exactitud. Me cuesta llevar la cuenta del tiempo.
Celebrations in Smoke#227.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#228.src: Yes! I've never lost anything like that before and I definitely haven't stolen anything ever at all.
Celebrations in Smoke#228.dst: ¡Sí! Nunca había perdido algo así y desde luego no he robado nada en mi vida.
Celebrations in Smoke#228.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#229.src: ... Although, I was caught sleeping while on watch a few times. And my clan got really upset with me for that, even though I promise nothing bad happened.
Celebrations in Smoke#229.dst: ... Aunque sí me pillaron durmiendo alguna vez estando de guardia. Y mi clan se enfadó mucho por eso, aunque te prometo que no pasó nada malo.
Celebrations in Smoke#229.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#230.src: I wasn't trying to sleep, but it's so hard to stay up all night while nothing is happening.
Celebrations in Smoke#230.dst: No es que quisiera dormirme, pero cuesta mucho aguantar toda la noche sin que pase nada.
Celebrations in Smoke#230.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#232.src: Oh, uh, well you know. I was, um.
Celebrations in Smoke#232.dst: Ah, eh, pues ya sabes. Es que, eh.
Celebrations in Smoke#232.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#234.src: And this was the only place I could think of that would have any and I really missed not having to run across the {p} trying to forage and I really really hate being exiled and I need somewhere to go.
Celebrations in Smoke#234.dst: Y este era el único sitio que se me ocurría donde habría algo y echaba muchísimo de menos no tener que recorrer {p} buscando comida y odio muchísimo el destierro y necesito un sitio al que ir.
Celebrations in Smoke#234.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#235.src: Sorry, I didn't mean to dump all my troubles on you.
Celebrations in Smoke#235.dst: Perdona, no quería soltarte todos mis problemas.
Celebrations in Smoke#235.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#237.src: Um. If it wouldn't be too much to ask.
Celebrations in Smoke#237.dst: Eh. Si no es mucho pedir.
Celebrations in Smoke#237.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#238.src: Would you mind getting me a Fortune Cookie?
Celebrations in Smoke#238.dst: ¿Te importaría traerme una galleta de la fortuna?
Celebrations in Smoke#238.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#239.src: I don't want to burden you or anything and I know I just lied to you and you're trying to investigate me for a horrible crime, but I'm really hungry and didn't get a chance to eat before you all shoved me in here.
Celebrations in Smoke#239.dst: No quiero ser una carga ni nada y sé que acabo de mentirte y que me estás investigando por un crimen horrible, pero tengo muchísima hambre y no pude comer antes de que me metierais aquí.
Celebrations in Smoke#239.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#240.src: Thank you so so so so much.
Celebrations in Smoke#240.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#241.src: Thank you! I don't think I've had one of these since I was a kid.
Celebrations in Smoke#241.dst: ¡Gracias! Creo que no comía una de estas desde la infancia.
Celebrations in Smoke#241.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#242.src: Here, let me read my fortune to you.
Celebrations in Smoke#242.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#243.src: "Beware some of those closest to you! They may not be what they seem."
Celebrations in Smoke#243.dst: "¡Cuidado con algunos de tus allegados! Puede que no sean lo que parecen."
Celebrations in Smoke#243.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#244.src: That, uh, would have been more useful a couple weeks ago.
Celebrations in Smoke#244.dst: Eso, eh, me habría venido mejor hace un par de semanas.
Celebrations in Smoke#244.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#246.src: Sorry. Please don't think I did whatever I can tell you think I did.
Celebrations in Smoke#246.dst: Perdona. No pienses que hice eso que noto que crees que hice.
Celebrations in Smoke#246.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#247.src: Thank you! I don't think I've had one of these since I was a kid.
Celebrations in Smoke#247.dst: ¡Gracias! Creo que no comía una de estas desde la infancia.
Celebrations in Smoke#247.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#248.src: Here, let me read my fortune to you.
Celebrations in Smoke#248.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#249.src: "Beware some of those closest to you! They may not be what they seem."
Celebrations in Smoke#249.dst: "¡Cuidado con algunos de tus allegados! Puede que no sean lo que parecen."
Celebrations in Smoke#249.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#250.src: That, uh, would have been more useful a couple weeks ago.
Celebrations in Smoke#250.dst: Eso, eh, me habría venido mejor hace un par de semanas.
Celebrations in Smoke#250.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#251.src: Burick. I'm simply a humble green tea trader.
Celebrations in Smoke#251.dst: Burick. Solo soy un humilde comerciante de té verde.

Celebrations in Smoke#252.src: I don't know what happened, I wasn't involved, and that's all I have to say.
Celebrations in Smoke#252.dst: No sé qué pasó, no estuve implicado y no tengo nada más que decir.
Celebrations in Smoke#252.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#254.src: I found this burnt medallion, confirming what I was told by a former clan member of yours. You were exiled for theft.
Celebrations in Smoke#254.dst: Encontré este medallón quemado; confirma lo que me dijo un excompañero de tu clan. Te desterraron por robar.

Celebrations in Smoke#255.src: That should be enough to go off if you can find someone who buys a lot of green tea. If you want to get more information though, you can continue the interrogation.
Celebrations in Smoke#255.dst: Con eso basta para seguir la pista si encuentras a alguien que compre mucho té verde. Si quieres más información, puedes continuar el interrogatorio.

similar.text: That should be enough to go off if you can find someone who was observant enough to see Cerisa sneak in. If you want to get more information though, you can continue the interrogation.

Celebrations in Smoke#256.src: One clan wants to get rid of stuff, while another clan wants to get their hands on it.
Celebrations in Smoke#256.dst: Un clan quiere deshacerse de algo y otro clan quiere hacerse con ello.
Celebrations in Smoke#256.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#257.src: The {p} is a big and dangerous place. They need a trader to make it happen.
Celebrations in Smoke#257.dst: {p} es un lugar grande y peligroso. Necesitan un comerciante para lograrlo.
Celebrations in Smoke#257.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#258.src: Yes. Someone has to do it though.
Celebrations in Smoke#258.dst: Sí. Pero alguien tiene que hacerlo.
Celebrations in Smoke#258.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#259.src: Nope. And neither has anyone else I've spoken to.
Celebrations in Smoke#259.dst: No. Ni nadie más con quien haya hablado.
Celebrations in Smoke#259.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#260.src: I'm not even certain they're real.
Celebrations in Smoke#260.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#262.src: Don't mention to anyone else that I said that.
Celebrations in Smoke#262.dst: No le menciones a nadie que he dicho eso.
Celebrations in Smoke#262.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#263.src: Some people get really upset when you imply that.
Celebrations in Smoke#263.dst: Hay quien se enfada mucho si insinúas eso.
Celebrations in Smoke#263.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#264.src: The Kalkalrah clan sells it to me. So wherever they get it, I suppose.
Celebrations in Smoke#264.dst: Me lo vende el clan Kalkalrah. Así que de donde lo saquen ellos, supongo.
Celebrations in Smoke#264.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#265.src: Yes. That's what a merchant is.
Celebrations in Smoke#265.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#266.src: I'm not a member of any clan. I travel around selling my products.
Celebrations in Smoke#266.dst: No pertenezco a ningún clan. Viajo vendiendo mis productos.
Celebrations in Smoke#266.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#267.src: Clan life would be too stifling. I like getting to see more than the trunk of a single tree.
Celebrations in Smoke#267.dst: La vida de clan sería demasiado asfixiante. Me gusta ver algo más que el tronco de un solo árbol.
Celebrations in Smoke#267.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#270.src: I'm a merchant, not a member of a clan.
Celebrations in Smoke#270.dst: Soy mercader, no miembro de un clan.
Celebrations in Smoke#270.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#271.src: I don't have a way to get one and it hasn't been a problem.
Celebrations in Smoke#271.dst: No tengo forma de conseguir uno y nunca ha sido un problema.
Celebrations in Smoke#271.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#272.src: I walked closely behind a group that did.
Celebrations in Smoke#272.dst: Fui pegado a un grupo que sí tenía.
Celebrations in Smoke#272.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#274.src: Gives me a good chance to investigate the green tea market too.
Celebrations in Smoke#274.dst: También es buena ocasión para estudiar el mercado del té verde.
Celebrations in Smoke#274.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#275.dst: No se fiaban mucho de mí.
Celebrations in Smoke#275.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#276.src: Trades were handled quickly, while the other parties were heavily armed, and in small enough quantities that if I was a changeling no major loss would be incurred.
Celebrations in Smoke#276.dst: Los tratos eran rápidos, la otra parte iba muy armada y las cantidades eran lo bastante pequeñas como para que, si yo fuera un cambiaformas, la pérdida no fuera grave.
Celebrations in Smoke#276.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#278.src: I did not and I would not hazard a guess as to who did.
Celebrations in Smoke#278.dst: No lo vi y tampoco me aventuraría a decir quién fue.
Celebrations in Smoke#278.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#279.src: I am answering your questions to the best of my knowledge and ability.
Celebrations in Smoke#279.dst: Respondo a tus preguntas lo mejor que sé y puedo.
Celebrations in Smoke#279.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#280.src: Isn't it your job to figure that stuff out?
Celebrations in Smoke#280.dst: ¿No es tu trabajo averiguar esas cosas?
Celebrations in Smoke#280.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#281.src: I see no reason to do your own work and give you more rope to hang me with.
Celebrations in Smoke#281.dst: No veo por qué hacer tu trabajo y darte más cuerda para ahorcarme.
Celebrations in Smoke#281.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#282.dst: Es solo una forma de hablar.
Celebrations in Smoke#282.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#283.src: I'm cooperating. But I don't see why I should trust someone I don't know or trust with more details than they need.
Celebrations in Smoke#283.dst: Coopero. Pero no veo por qué dar a alguien que no conozco ni en quien confío más detalles de los necesarios.
Celebrations in Smoke#283.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#284.src: It would be helpful for my business if you just let me go.
Celebrations in Smoke#284.dst: A mi negocio le vendría bien que me dejaras marchar.
Celebrations in Smoke#284.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#285.src: But I'm not demanding that. You can give me the same etiquette.
Celebrations in Smoke#285.dst: Pero no lo estoy exigiendo. Tú puedes tener la misma cortesía.
Celebrations in Smoke#285.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#287.src: Sure, but I have no use for your emeralds.
Celebrations in Smoke#287.dst: Claro, pero tus esmeraldas no me sirven de nada.
Celebrations in Smoke#287.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#288.src: It's been a while since I've had some rabbit roast. Get some of that for me and I'll see what I can do.
Celebrations in Smoke#288.dst: Hace tiempo que no como asado de conejo. Tráeme un poco y veré qué puedo hacer.
Celebrations in Smoke#288.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#289.src: Huh. I didn't think you actually would, thanks.
Celebrations in Smoke#289.dst: Vaya. No creí que lo harías de verdad, gracias.
Celebrations in Smoke#289.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#290.src: Anyway, I'm terse because I'm used to being. It doesn't really have anything to do with you.
Celebrations in Smoke#290.dst: En fin, soy seco porque estoy acostumbrado. No tiene nada que ver contigo.
Celebrations in Smoke#290.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#291.src: I spend so much time alone by myself in the woods that I'm not used to making conversation, even when it's needed.
Celebrations in Smoke#291.dst: Paso tanto tiempo solo en el bosque que no estoy acostumbrado a conversar, ni siquiera cuando hace falta.
Celebrations in Smoke#291.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#292.src: Sorry, you seem nice, I wish I could be of more use to your investigation.
Celebrations in Smoke#292.dst: Perdona, pareces buena gente; ojalá sirviera de más a tu investigación.
Celebrations in Smoke#292.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#293.src: I have enough of them as is.
Celebrations in Smoke#293.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#294.src: Most of the time I trade in kind anyway.
Celebrations in Smoke#294.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#298.src: I don't know and you're not getting a guess out of me.
Celebrations in Smoke#298.dst: No lo sé, y no vas a sacarme una conjetura.
Celebrations in Smoke#298.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#299.src: I could have missed something, but I didn't see any of us do it.
Celebrations in Smoke#299.dst: Se me pudo escapar algo, pero no vi que ninguno lo hiciera.
Celebrations in Smoke#299.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#300.src: Find someone who might be familiar with a green tea merchant.
Celebrations in Smoke#300.dst: Encuentra a alguien que pueda conocer a un mercader de té verde.

Celebrations in Smoke#301.src: It's the festival again! And you know what that means...
Celebrations in Smoke#301.dst: ¡Ya está aquí el festival otra vez! Y ya sabes lo que eso significa...
Celebrations in Smoke#301.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#302.src: Green tea!!! I never know how to get this stuff outside the festival.
Celebrations in Smoke#302.dst: ¡¡¡Té verde!!! Fuera del festival nunca sé dónde conseguirlo.
Celebrations in Smoke#302.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#303.src: I'm going to spend all night standing right here, drinking as much of it as I can!
Celebrations in Smoke#303.dst: ¡Voy a pasarme aquí toda la noche bebiendo todo el que pueda!
Celebrations in Smoke#303.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#305.src: Please, tell me, I would love to know. I've been searching for one for years.
Celebrations in Smoke#305.dst: Por favor, dímelo, me encantaría saberlo. Llevo años buscando uno.
Celebrations in Smoke#305.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#306.src: The closest I got was some odd tent in the woods east of {p} with a box of the stuff, but that just a scavenger's tent.
Celebrations in Smoke#306.dst: Lo más cerca que estuve fue una tienda rara en el bosque al este de {p} con una caja del producto, pero era solo la tienda de un carroñero.
Celebrations in Smoke#306.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#307.src: I wish the Kalkalrah clan wouldn't keep the secret so well hidden.
Celebrations in Smoke#307.dst: Ojalá el clan Kalkalrah no guardara el secreto tan bien.
Celebrations in Smoke#307.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#308.src: No, of course not. They keep it a secret, hoarding it up all year, so they can charge us extra during the festival.
Celebrations in Smoke#308.dst: No, claro que no. Lo mantienen en secreto y lo acaparan todo el año para cobrarnos de más en el festival.
Celebrations in Smoke#308.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#309.src: They do all this under the guise of it being "mystical" and "only suited for ceremonial occasions like this," but everyone sees through their sales techniques.
Celebrations in Smoke#309.dst: Lo hacen todo con la excusa de que es "místico" y "solo apto para ocasiones ceremoniales como esta", pero todo el mundo les ve el truco comercial.
Celebrations in Smoke#309.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#310.src: ... not that it stops me from buying every bottle I can get my hands on. It feels amazing.
Celebrations in Smoke#310.dst: ... lo cual no me impide comprar todas las botellas que pillo. Sienta de maravilla.
Celebrations in Smoke#310.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#311.src: Okay, you have to be holding out on me.
Celebrations in Smoke#311.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#312.src: Come on, give me the name. What do you want, emeralds? Information? I'll give it to you, just tell me where I can find a year round green tea merchant.
Celebrations in Smoke#312.dst: Vamos, dame el nombre. ¿Qué quieres, esmeraldas? ¿Información? Te lo doy, solo dime dónde encontrar un mercader de té verde todo el año.
Celebrations in Smoke#312.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#313.src: What are you wasting my time for then?
Celebrations in Smoke#313.dst: ¿Pues por qué me haces perder el tiempo?
Celebrations in Smoke#313.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#314.src: If you get any leads on that tea trader, make sure to let me know right away.
Celebrations in Smoke#314.dst: Si consigues alguna pista de ese comerciante de té, avísame enseguida.
Celebrations in Smoke#314.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#315.src: You must not have spoken to the people I sold to then.
Celebrations in Smoke#315.dst: Pues no habrás hablado con la gente a la que vendí.
Celebrations in Smoke#315.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#316.src: Not sure how much of an enthusiast they could be if they don't know me.
Celebrations in Smoke#316.dst: No sé qué clase de aficionado será si no me conoce.
Celebrations in Smoke#316.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#317.src: Even so, that's only the words of one person. I won't pretend to know everyone in the {p}. Even the ones I do meet I don't make a major impression on.
Celebrations in Smoke#317.dst: Aun así, es la palabra de una sola persona. No voy a fingir que conozco a todo el mundo en {p}. Y a quienes conozco no les dejo mucha huella.
Celebrations in Smoke#317.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#319.src: Search for a camp east of {p} [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] that Burick might have been spotted at.
Celebrations in Smoke#319.dst: Busca un campamento al este de {p}, en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}], donde quizá vieran a Burick.

Celebrations in Smoke#321.src: What else would I need? I'm sure while you were violating my privacy you snooped through my stuff. I have nothing to hide.
Celebrations in Smoke#321.dst: ¿Qué más iba a necesitar? Seguro que, mientras violabas mi intimidad, fisgaste entre mis cosas. No tengo nada que ocultar.
Celebrations in Smoke#321.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#322.src: There simply isn't much excess gear that I need as a merchant.
Celebrations in Smoke#322.dst: Como mercader no necesito mucho equipo de más.
Celebrations in Smoke#322.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#325.src: You're not believing that, are you.
Celebrations in Smoke#325.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#326.src: Fine. I'm not really a merchant.
Celebrations in Smoke#326.dst: Está bien. No soy mercader de verdad.
Celebrations in Smoke#326.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#327.src: I'm a scavenger. I was born without a clan and have lived my entire life without one.
Celebrations in Smoke#327.dst: Soy un carroñero. Nací sin clan y he vivido toda mi vida sin uno.
Celebrations in Smoke#327.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#328.src: When pressed, I pose as a merchant. I've spent enough time wandering the {p} that I have enough knowledge to be one.
Celebrations in Smoke#328.dst: Cuando me presionan, me hago pasar por mercader. He vagado por {p} lo suficiente para saber hacerlo.
Celebrations in Smoke#328.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#329.src: Still though, that's all. I won't pretend I didn't lie to you, but beside that I'm telling the truth.
Celebrations in Smoke#329.dst: Pero eso es todo. No fingiré que no te mentí, pero aparte de eso digo la verdad.
Celebrations in Smoke#329.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#330.src: I don't know who tried to burn down the wickerman or why. It certainly wasn't me.
Celebrations in Smoke#330.dst: No sé quién intentó quemar al hombre de mimbre ni por qué. Desde luego no fui yo.
Celebrations in Smoke#330.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#331.src: There's not much to do out in the wilderness. Only so many times I can forage the same bush for food or admire the same river.
Celebrations in Smoke#331.dst: En plena naturaleza no hay mucho que hacer. Solo puedes rebuscar en el mismo arbusto o admirar el mismo río un número de veces.
Celebrations in Smoke#331.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#332.src: I get lonely. I still am lonely.
Celebrations in Smoke#332.dst: Me siento solo. Y lo sigo estando.
Celebrations in Smoke#332.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#333.src: The festival is the only time of year I really get to be with others, I've been attending for years now.
Celebrations in Smoke#333.dst: El festival es la única época del año en que estoy con gente; llevo años viniendo.
Celebrations in Smoke#333.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#334.src: Not that I can speak to anyone much. They might realize I'm not supposed to be here.
Celebrations in Smoke#334.dst: Aunque tampoco puedo hablar mucho con nadie. Podrían darse cuenta de que no debería estar aquí.
Celebrations in Smoke#334.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#335.src: How did you actually get in?
Celebrations in Smoke#335.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#336.src: I've managed to find a spot in the {p} wall where you can leap over and the guards can't see. I'm amazed they haven't fixed it yet.
Celebrations in Smoke#336.dst: Encontré un punto en la muralla de {p} por donde se puede saltar sin que te vean los guardias. Me asombra que no lo hayan arreglado.
Celebrations in Smoke#336.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#337.src: Come to think of it, if someone else was coming here uninvited, that's probably how they got in too.
Celebrations in Smoke#337.dst: Ahora que lo pienso, si alguien más vino sin invitación, seguramente entró por ahí.
Celebrations in Smoke#337.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#338.src: I found it lying on the ground a few weeks ago, cracked open and half empty.
Celebrations in Smoke#338.dst: La encontré en el suelo hace unas semanas, rota y medio vacía.
Celebrations in Smoke#338.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#339.src: Someone must have lost it or something, maybe a patrol of soldiers? That would be odd though, they're usually quite tidy.
Celebrations in Smoke#339.dst: Alguien la perdería o algo así, ¿quizá una patrulla de soldados? Aunque sería raro, suelen ser bastante pulcros.
Celebrations in Smoke#339.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#340.src: It could have been one of the clans too. At least one of them knows how to produce the stuff.
Celebrations in Smoke#340.dst: También pudo ser uno de los clanes. Al menos uno de ellos sabe fabricarlo.
Celebrations in Smoke#340.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#341.src: I don't know, but I'm glad I found it! It's been too long since I've managed to drink any.
Celebrations in Smoke#341.dst: No lo sé, ¡pero me alegro de haberla encontrado! Hacía demasiado que no probaba nada.
Celebrations in Smoke#341.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#342.src: I hope you didn't confiscate it while you were snooping through my home.
Celebrations in Smoke#342.dst: Espero que no la confiscaras mientras fisgabas en mi casa.
Celebrations in Smoke#342.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#343.src: My parents were exiled, I think?
Celebrations in Smoke#343.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#344.src: I've never really gotten the entirety of that story, so I'm unsure.
Celebrations in Smoke#344.dst: Nunca me contaron esa historia entera, así que no lo sé.
Celebrations in Smoke#344.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#345.src: I don't really feel like going deeper into it than that.
Celebrations in Smoke#345.dst: No me apetece profundizar más en ello.
Celebrations in Smoke#345.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#346.src: It's nice to meet you too. I'm Cerisa, a petty thief.
Celebrations in Smoke#346.dst: Encantada igualmente. Soy Cerisa, una ladronzuela.

Celebrations in Smoke#347.src: I snuck into the festival to snag shiny trinkets and whatever else I could get my hands on.
Celebrations in Smoke#347.dst: Me colé en el festival para llevarme baratijas brillantes y todo lo que pudiera.
Celebrations in Smoke#347.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#348.src: I was also completely uninvolved in who or what tried to burn down the wickerman, so you can let me go whenever you're ready to.
Celebrations in Smoke#348.dst: Tampoco tuve nada que ver con quien o lo que intentó quemar al hombre de mimbre, así que puedes soltarme cuando quieras.
Celebrations in Smoke#348.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#349.src: Did you have anything else you wanted to know?
Celebrations in Smoke#349.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#350.src: Because you'd figure it out one way or another, I don't have a more respectable occupation to cover it up with that you wouldn't quickly disprove.
Celebrations in Smoke#350.dst: Porque lo averiguarías de un modo u otro; no tengo un oficio más respetable con el que taparlo que no refutaras enseguida.
Celebrations in Smoke#350.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#351.src: It'd be irrational to hide my criminal nature when that is precisely what you're searching for.
Celebrations in Smoke#351.dst: Sería irracional ocultar mi naturaleza criminal cuando es justo lo que buscas.
Celebrations in Smoke#351.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#352.src: If I deceived you and you found out, you would surely take it as evidence that I had even more to hide.
Celebrations in Smoke#352.dst: Si te engañara y lo descubrieras, lo tomarías como prueba de que oculto aún más.
Celebrations in Smoke#352.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#353.src: My solitary purpose right now is to convince you that I did not try to burn the effigy. I can deal with the consequences of being exposed as a thief later.
Celebrations in Smoke#353.dst: Mi único propósito ahora es convencerte de que no intenté quemar la efigie. Ya afrontaré después las consecuencias de quedar expuesta como ladrona.
Celebrations in Smoke#353.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#354.src: Of course not, that would be contrary to my overall purpose.
Celebrations in Smoke#354.dst: Claro que no, sería contrario a mi propósito general.
Celebrations in Smoke#354.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#355.src: Mind you, I don't expect you to believe me when I say that. You should definitely act as though I am lying to you.
Celebrations in Smoke#355.dst: Ojo, no espero que me creas al decirlo. Deberías actuar como si te estuviera mintiendo.
Celebrations in Smoke#355.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#356.src: But I won't. You trusting me is my best ticket out of this mess.
Celebrations in Smoke#356.dst: Pero no lo haré. Que confíes en mí es mi mejor salida de este lío.
Celebrations in Smoke#356.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#357.src: I do. I have no idea what they'd do to me and I don't want to find out.
Celebrations in Smoke#357.dst: Sí. No sé qué me harían y no quiero averiguarlo.
Celebrations in Smoke#357.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#358.src: From what I was able to overhear between you and the organizer, it sounds like you're looking for a changeling.
Celebrations in Smoke#358.dst: Por lo que pude oír entre el organizador y tú, parece que buscas un cambiaformas.
Celebrations in Smoke#358.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#359.src: And based on what they do to just an effigy of a changeling, I have absolutely no desire to find out what would happen to me if they actually thought I was one.
Celebrations in Smoke#359.dst: Y viendo lo que le hacen a una simple efigie de cambiaformas, no tengo ningunas ganas de descubrir qué me harían si creyeran que lo soy.
Celebrations in Smoke#359.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#360.src: I'll take whatever punishment my thievery gets me and move on.
Celebrations in Smoke#360.dst: Aceptaré el castigo que me gane por robar y seguiré adelante.
Celebrations in Smoke#360.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#361.src: Of course, I'll talk about whatever you want.
Celebrations in Smoke#361.dst: Por supuesto, hablaré de lo que quieras.
Celebrations in Smoke#361.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#363.src: Of course. I'll talk about whatever you want.
Celebrations in Smoke#363.dst: Por supuesto. Hablaré de lo que quieras.
Celebrations in Smoke#363.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#364.src: Yes. Being outside of a clan, there's no one particularly trustworthy in the {p}.
Celebrations in Smoke#364.dst: Sí. Fuera de un clan, en {p} no hay nadie especialmente de fiar.
Celebrations in Smoke#364.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#365.src: With the changelings, even if I were to find a partner, I don't know how to make medallions and so could never be sure they weren't killed and replaced.
Celebrations in Smoke#365.dst: Con los cambiaformas, aunque encontrara un socio, no sé hacer medallones, así que nunca sabría si lo han matado y suplantado.
Celebrations in Smoke#365.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#366.src: It's much easier this way, I assure you.
Celebrations in Smoke#366.dst: Así es mucho más fácil, te lo aseguro.
Celebrations in Smoke#366.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#367.src: Whoever I can. For the most part it's the clans, they can be shockingly lazy if you know where you're looking.
Celebrations in Smoke#367.dst: A quien pueda. Sobre todo a los clanes; son asombrosamente descuidados si sabes dónde mirar.
Celebrations in Smoke#367.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#368.src: I have stolen a bit from the military when their watch lapses, although that's obviously much harder to pull off.
Celebrations in Smoke#368.dst: Al ejército también le he robado algo cuando baja la guardia, aunque eso es mucho más difícil.
Celebrations in Smoke#368.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#369.src: Not personally, no. I've heard some rumors though.
Celebrations in Smoke#369.dst: En persona no. Aunque he oído rumores.
Celebrations in Smoke#369.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#370.src: Hard to tell fact from fiction, but they certainly seem to be a nasty bunch.
Celebrations in Smoke#370.dst: Cuesta separar el hecho de la ficción, pero parecen gente desagradable.
Celebrations in Smoke#370.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#371.src: I wouldn't be surprised to hear one tried to break into the festival.
Celebrations in Smoke#371.dst: No me sorprendería que uno intentara colarse en el festival.
Celebrations in Smoke#371.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#372.src: Of course, I'll talk about whatever you want.
Celebrations in Smoke#372.dst: Por supuesto, hablaré de lo que quieras.
Celebrations in Smoke#372.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#373.src: Not directly, no. But of the three of us, I was the farthest from where the flame was kindled.
Celebrations in Smoke#373.dst: Directamente no. Pero de los tres, yo era la que estaba más lejos de donde prendió la llama.
Celebrations in Smoke#373.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#374.src: I may have seen one of the other two suspects move, but I can't be positive about that.
Celebrations in Smoke#374.dst: Puede que viera moverse a uno de los otros dos sospechosos, pero no lo aseguro.
Celebrations in Smoke#374.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#375.src: If I had more information I would of course provide it.
Celebrations in Smoke#375.dst: Si tuviera más información, por supuesto la daría.
Celebrations in Smoke#375.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#376.src: Ah, have you decided to try and play confrontational?
Celebrations in Smoke#376.dst: Ah, ¿has decidido ponerte en plan agresivo?
Celebrations in Smoke#376.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#377.src: That's fine, I will reiterate that I didn't do it. Whether you believe me or not, that is the truth.
Celebrations in Smoke#377.dst: No pasa nada, reiteraré que no fui yo. Me creas o no, esa es la verdad.
Celebrations in Smoke#377.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#378.src: My fate lies entirely in your hands, so to speak. You don't have to engage in theatrics to intimidate me, you are exactly as scary as you were before.
Celebrations in Smoke#378.dst: Mi destino está, por así decirlo, enteramente en tus manos. No hace falta teatro para intimidarme: das el mismo miedo que antes.
Celebrations in Smoke#378.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#379.src: Find someone who might have been observant enough to see Cerisa sneak in.
Celebrations in Smoke#379.dst: Encuentra a alguien lo bastante observador como para haber visto colarse a Cerisa.

Celebrations in Smoke#380.src: Isn't it nice to see kids having fun?
Celebrations in Smoke#380.dst: ¿A que da gusto ver a los críos jugar?
Celebrations in Smoke#380.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#381.src: I try to lighten his life when I can, but it's so hard to some days.
Celebrations in Smoke#381.dst: Intento alegrarle la vida cuando puedo, pero hay días muy duros.
Celebrations in Smoke#381.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#382.src: That's why I love the festival. Makes my job easier!
Celebrations in Smoke#382.dst: Por eso me encanta el festival. ¡Me facilita el trabajo!
Celebrations in Smoke#382.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#383.src: He can entertain himself, I can watch for danger.
